description: The window's permissions, for the app's own page alone: the bundle's, on the app's local origin, and no remote URL. Beside the shell's commands it takes four of Tauri's own: core:event listen and unlisten, for the page's update-state and leaving events, and core:window start-dragging and internal-toggle-maximize, which Tauri's data-tauri-drag-region script calls when the title bar's drag strip is dragged or double-clicked, so no page code names either.
